user.title: Topology
user.description: Set up the Topology helper. There is nothing to configure here — selecting Submit validates the area registry and the topology store, then creates the entry. All home settings are edited in the Topology panel.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Topology
reconfigure.description: Re-run the Topology setup checks and reload the integration. This step changes no settings — home settings are edited in the Topology panel.

error.area_registry_unavailable: The area registry could not be read. Please try again.
error.store_corrupt: The topology store could not be read. It may be corrupt; restore from a backup and try again.

abort.store_future_version: The topology store was written by a newer version of the integration and cannot be read after a downgrade.

annotate_area.name: Annotate area
annotate_area.description: Set the topology type, environment, or trust of an area. Only the provided fields are changed.

type.name: Type
type.description: The area type (open catalog — any value is allowed).

environment.name: Environment
environment.description: The enclosure class of the area.

trust.name: Trust
trust.description: The access-trust class of the area.

declare_connection.name: Declare connection
declare_connection.description: Create or replace the interior connection between two areas from a named preset.

area_b.name: Second area
area_b.description: The other endpoint of the connection.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The connection preset, which expands to a passage and a barrier.

side.name: Side
side.description: The rough cardinal bearing of the connection (optional).

glazed.name: Glazed
glazed.description: Whether the connection is glazed. Defaults to the preset's value.

sensor.name: Door sensor
sensor.description: A binary_sensor entity for a door-barrier connection (optional).

set_beyond.name: Set beyond
set_beyond.description: Annotate — or clear — what lies beyond one outer-wall side of an area.

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: The area whose outer wall is annotated.

side.name: Side
side.description: The cardinal side of the outer wall.

beyond.name: Beyond
beyond.description: What lies beyond that side. Omit to clear the side.

set_exterior.name: Set exterior connections
set_exterior.description: Replace an area's exterior-connection list atomically (windows and outside doors on outer walls).

area_id.name: Area
area_id.description: The area whose exterior connections are replaced.

connections.name: Connections
connections.description: The full list of exterior connection objects. An empty list clears them.

set_floor_level.name: Set floor level
set_floor_level.description: Store or clear a floor-level override where the registry level is unset.

floor_id.name: Floor
floor_id.description: The floor whose level override is set.

level.name: Level
level.description: The floor level (may be negative for basements). Omit to clear the override.

project_labels.name: Project labels
project_labels.description: Run the one-way label projection, writing topology annotations onto owned area labels.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: Which enabled dimension to project. Defaults to all enabled dimensions.

import_from_core.name: Import from core
import_from_core.description: Seed area annotations once from existing area aliases or labels. Never overwrites existing values.

source.name: Source
source.description: Whether to import from area aliases or area labels.

not_loaded.message: No topology configuration entry is loaded.

area_not_found.message: Area {area_id} is not in the area registry.

floor_not_found.message: Floor {floor_id} is not in the floor registry.

same_area.message: A connection needs two different areas, but both endpoints are {area_id}.

sensor_requires_door.message: A sensor can only be bound to a door-barrier connection.

invalid_sensor.message: Sensor {sensor} is not a valid binary_sensor entity id.

nothing_to_update.message: Provide at least one of type, environment, or trust to update.

projection_disabled.message: The {dimension} projection is disabled; enable it before projecting that dimension.

store_future_version.title: Topology store is from a newer version
store_future_version.description: The topology store on disk is schema version {version}, which is newer than this installation supports. Topology cannot load until you upgrade the integration again or restore a compatible backup.

unknown_enum_after_downgrade.title: Topology store has unrecognized values
unknown_enum_after_downgrade.description: The topology store contains at least one value this version does not recognize (for example {field} = "{value}"), likely from a newer release. {count} such value(s) are shown as unknown and are preserved untouched; upgrade the integration again to restore them.

unannotated_areas_threshold.title: Several areas are not annotated
unannotated_areas_threshold.description: {count} area(s) have no topology annotation, at or above your configured threshold of {threshold}. Annotate them so the topology model reflects your home. This suggestion clears once fewer than {threshold} areas remain unannotated.

confirm.title: Purge orphaned topology entries
confirm.description: {count} topology entries reference areas or floors that were removed from the registry. They are kept for a short undo window in case you restore the area. Select Submit to purge them now, or dismiss this to let the daily cleanup remove them after the window elapses.

isolated_areas.title: Some areas are not connected
isolated_areas.description: {count} area(s) have no interior connection to any other area, so they are isolated in the topology graph. Add an interior connection for each so the graph is complete. This suggestion clears once every area is connected.

indoor_areas_without_floor.title: Indoor areas have no floor
indoor_areas_without_floor.description: {count} indoor area(s) are not assigned to a floor while the rest of your home uses floors. Assign a floor in Home Assistant so the topology model is complete. This suggestion clears once every indoor area has a floor.

contradictory_bearings.title: Contradictory wall bearings
contradictory_bearings.description: {count} area(s) use the same cardinal side both for an interior connection and for a beyond declaration, which cannot both be true. Review the affected sides so each is used consistently. This suggestion clears once the contradiction is resolved.

exterior_on_non_outdoor_side.title: Exterior opening on a non-outdoor side
exterior_on_non_outdoor_side.description: {count} area(s) declare an exterior opening on a side that faces earth or a glazed opening onto a neighbor, which is not physically possible. Review the affected openings so each faces a valid side. This suggestion clears once the openings are corrected.

edges_spanning_multiple_floors.title: Connections spanning more than one floor
edges_spanning_multiple_floors.description: {count} connection(s) join areas more than one floor apart. That is real in a void, an atrium or a maisonette, so nothing is blocked — but it more often means an area sits on the wrong floor. Check the floor assignments of the areas involved, or leave the connection as it is. This suggestion clears once no connection spans more than one floor.

vertical_edges_without_vertical_passage.title: Connection between floors with no way to climb
vertical_edges_without_vertical_passage.description: {count} connection(s) join areas on different floors, but none of them offers stairs, a ramp, a lift, a ladder or a hatch — so nothing can actually get from one to the other. Usually the wrong kind was picked (an interior door where a stair belongs). A plain shared ceiling is a legitimate exception. This suggestion clears once each such connection carries a climbing kind.
